reader_note: The value covers the cut from 14 to 12 directors and the 12 nominees, the departures of J.W. Marriott, Jr. and Kellner, David S. Marriott as Chairman-elect and Henderson as Lead Director-elect, every independence determination, the six committees and the independence of the four key ones, the Audit Committee's financial-literacy and expert findings, the ISIC list, the Audit and HRCC report signatures and the AC/NCGC chair successions; block 1145 concerns a management committee, and many selected blocks are narrative with the facts embedded. No selected block states the TISOC members and chair (McCarthy), the Executive Committee members and chairs (J.W. Marriott, Jr., then David S. Marriott), Lee's NCGC seat, the separation of the Chairman and CEO roles since 2012, Goren's joining the Board on March 1, 2022 or Capuano's election to the Board in 2021 (pool blocks 934, 982, 991, 993, the director cards, the nominee table, 274/349/583-610, 842, 1144). The nominee summary table (blocks 287-339) lost its column positions, so its C/M/F marks were matched to committees through the committee pages, and the HRCC/NCGC/TISOC 'Current Members:' labels are split over two blocks.
